issues: Header renders navigation links as <button> elements with onClick navigation instead of <a> links, causing the tests to be unable to find a unique link with name /services/i. Change navLinks to use <Link> (or <a>) elements with proper href attributes and accessible names, and ensure the "Explore services" hero button remains a link so there is only one link named "Services" for the test expectations.

Footer includes navigation links with aria‑hidden="true", making them focusable hidden elements and violating accessibility checks (aria‑hidden‑focus). Remove aria‑hidden or set tabindex="-1" on these links, and ensure they are regular visible links.

The design uses button elements for the primary "Book a consultation" CTA in the header, but the tests expect a role="button" rendered as a link. Convert the CTA to an <a> element with class "button-primary" and role="button" to satisfy the test and improve accessibility.

Multiple elements have insufficient color contrast (foreground #ffffff on background #1f8a8a). Adjust button text color or background to meet WCAG AA contrast ratio 4.5:1 for normal text (e.g., use a darker teal or darker text color).

The layout exceeds the 390px viewport width, causing horizontal scrolling on mobile. Ensure all containers use max-width:100% and proper padding; adjust .hero, .pillars, nav, and other elements to be responsive and not exceed the viewport.
feedback: The current implementation fails many acceptance tests and accessibility checks. Fix the navigation links, remove aria‑hidden from visible links, address contrast ratios, and ensure responsive layout without overflow. After these changes the tests should pass and the site will meet the specified requirements.
